description: The plot illustrates how loss changes with increasing computation (TFLOPs) for two training setups, “Vanilla” and “SepLLM,” shown as two line series on the same axes. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0.00 to 1.25 with a “1e9” multiplier indicated (i.e., 0 to 1.25×10^9 TFLOPs), with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.25 increments. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick labels at regular 0.05 intervals. The Vanilla series is drawn as a purple solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts near the left side around a loss of approximately 2.74–2.75 at low TFLOPs, then declines as TFLOPs increase, reaching about 2.63 around 0.25×10^9 TFLOPs and ending near 2.50 at about 1.20×10^9 TFLOPs. The SepLLM series is drawn as a red solid line with circular markers; it begins near a similar initial level around 2.74–2.75, drops more quickly early (reaching roughly 2.60 by about 0.20–0.25×10^9 TFLOPs), continues decreasing through about 2.54 around 0.50×10^9 TFLOPs, passes near 2.50 around 0.90×10^9 TFLOPs, and ends around 2.47 near 1.20×10^9 TFLOPs. A green dashed annotation highlights a region with a dashed horizontal line at Loss = 2.50 and dashed vertical boundaries roughly around 0.95×10^9 and 1.20×10^9 TFLOPs, with a double-headed arrow above labeled “1.28×.”
